description: Authoritative capability manifest for AIBA. Every registered tool MUST have an entry here before it can be enabled in config/permissions.json. Optional per-tool fields: feature_flag, optional_dependency (probe label: 'python:<module>' | 'binary:<exe>' | 'none'; unknown probe types FAIL CLOSED so a missing dependency can never report ready), internal_only (bool, default false) to mark a tool as registered purely for internal use so it is never advertised to the model. See docs/PLAN_v1.6_capability_parity.md.

risk_classes.read_only_local: Read or inspect local workspace data; no mutation. Approval not required.
risk_classes.read_only_network: Read-only public network access; strictly SSRF-safe against private/loopback/credential targets. Approval not required.
risk_classes.local_mutation: Writes, edits, archives, or otherwise mutates data inside the AIBA workspace. Approval required.
risk_classes.external_mutation: Causes a change on an external system (send, post, submit, purchase, authenticate). Approval required.
risk_classes.process_execution: Starts processes, runs shell/code, or sends process input. Approval required.
risk_classes.destructive: Deletes, terminates, or irreversibly destroys data or processes. Approval required.

feature_flags.AIBA_WEB_ENABLED: Gates the web_search / web_extract tools (read-only network).
feature_flags.AIBA_BROWSER_ENABLED: Gates browser tooling: browser_fetch and the Phase 4b browser_session family (browser_open/state/page_text/screenshot/wait/status/scroll/click/type/select/submit/download/upload). Requires installed browser dependencies (playwright + chromium). Disabled by default.
feature_flags.AIBA_DESKTOP_ENABLED: Gates computer-control tooling (desktop_screenshot / desktop_click / desktop_type). Disabled until the paired-node security phase is complete.
feature_flags.AIBA_VISION_ENABLED: Gates vision_analyze; requires a vision-capable model.
feature_flags.AIBA_SUBAGENTS_ENABLED: Gates delegate_task: bounded internal background workers (subagents) for parallel research/verification/planning/review. Disabled by default. Workers are permission-narrowed (never broader than the main agent), non-recursive, and run under hard step/time budgets.
feature_flags.none: No feature flag required (always available once enabled).

patch_file.description: Apply a find-and-replace edit to a workspace text file, atomically, returning the diff.

archive.description: Create a zip or tarball of a workspace path, written inside the workspace.

extract_archive.description: Extract a zip/tar archive into a workspace destination, blocking zip-slip.

web_search.description: Search the public web for a topic and return title/url/snippet results.

web_extract.description: Fetch readable text from one or more PUBLIC http(s) pages; SSRF-safe.

update_memory.description: Edit an existing memory row by id.

delete_memory.description: Delete a memory row by id (destructive).

list_memories.description: List stored memories, optionally filtered by category.

export_memories.description: Export memories (optionally one category) to a markdown file in the workspace.

session_search.description: Search past AIBA task/session history (this user only); never returns internal deliberation.

session_history.description: List recent AIBA sessions for this user.

browser_open.description: Navigate the managed browser to a PUBLIC http(s) URL (SSRF-safe) and return the final URL.

browser_state.description: Read the current browser page's structured state (URL + title).

browser_page_text.description: Read visible text from the current browser page.

browser_screenshot.description: Capture the current browser viewport to a PNG inside the approved workspace.

browser_wait.description: Wait up to a bounded timeout for an element selector to appear.

browser_scroll.description: Scroll the current browser page. Read-only viewport action.

browser_click.description: Click an element by selector or visible text. Alters the site; approval required.

browser_type.description: Type text into a field. Secret-like text is never logged and is refused on auth/payment pages.

browser_select.description: Select an option in a <select> element by value. Approval required.

browser_submit.description: Submit the current form. Approval required.

browser_download.description: Save a download triggered in the browser into the approved workspace. Approval required.

browser_upload.description: Upload a file ALREADY inside the approved workspace to a file input. Approval required.

browser_status.description: Report whether the automated browser session is enabled and open.

desktop_screen_size.description: Report the desktop screen size in pixels.

desktop_move.description: Move the pointer to screen coordinates.

desktop_drag.description: Drag the pointer between two screen coordinates.

desktop_scroll.description: Scroll the focused window by a number of clicks.

desktop_key.description: Press a single key (enter, tab, arrows, etc.).

desktop_hotkey.description: Press a modifier hotkey combination (e.g. ctrl+c).

desktop_open_url.description: Open an http(s) URL in the default browser.

desktop_clipboard_write.description: Set the clipboard to a string.

desktop_node_status.description: Report computer-node pairing status and remaining action budget.

skill_instructions.description: Read a reviewed portable skill instruction contract.

clarify.description: Ask the user one focused question with choices and tradeoffs.

delegate_task.description: Run bounded internal background workers in parallel for research/verification/planning/review. Disabled by default (AIBA_SUBAGENTS_ENABLED + permissions.json). AIBA stays the single user-facing assistant; workers are invisible, each bounded by its own objective, allowed-tool list, step/time/cost budget and global+per-parent concurrency. Workers cannot spawn further workers (no recursion); each runs within the shared policy and returns only a concise result summary (no raw prompts/transcripts/CoT). Provide concrete, self-contained objectives.
